messages:
alex: Quick FYI — opened PR #2640 to add a formatter exception for generated protos.
alex: This unblocks a tiny refactor but the change disables the varcase rule for the generated/*.go files.
alex: Planning to merge in the 3pm PT slot unless someone flags a problem.

tess: Thanks for the heads-up. Can you paste the snippet you used to opt-out? want to mirror in our generator.

alex: sure — added this to .golangci.yml under `linters-settings`: 
```yaml
linters-settings:
  varcase:
    ignore-patterns:
      - ^generated/.*\.go$
```

alex: also added a comment header to generated files: `// Code generated — do not edit. formatter:ignore`

cj: small ask — can we keep the header but avoid a global linter change? prefer targeted ignores per package.

alex: I tried package-level ignores but the generator writes to multiple dirs and CI still flagged some. global ignore for that pattern was easiest.

sylvia: If we do global pattern, can we add a short note in the PR description with rationale + signal to infra to revisit when generator changes? want audit trail.

alex: yep added rationale and linking to the generator issue (#409). Also added a TODO to remove when generator emits varcase-compliant names.

cj: OK. I can approve if you add that TODO and a short test that asserts `generated/` files match header. super small.

alex: done — added a test that fails if header missing. pinging @tess for one more eyeball.

merge-bot: CI passed on branch `pr/2640` — all checks green. :white_check_mark:

alex: planning to merge at 15:00 PT. If no objections by 14:40 I'll merge and squash.

tess: quick look now — :eyes:

tess: two super minor nits (spacing in comment, and add a one-line note in release notes). otherwise LGTM. :+1:

alex: thanks — fixed both.

cj: approving now. :+1:

sylvia: approving too.

alex: merging in 5. thanks all. :tada:

merge-bot: Merged PR #2640 into main at 1749406900.
